messages.content:
**Description**
A small Street Fighter 6 plugin that automatically declines Wi-Fi opponents during matchmaking.
The plugin reads the connection type reported by the game and tries to reject a Wi-Fi match before the confirmation screen. 

**Installation instructions**
1. Install REFramework for Street Fighter 6.
2. Download and extract RejectWifi.
3. Copy `RejectWifi.dll` into:
   `Street Fighter 6/reframework/plugins`
4. Start the game.

Settings can be changed at runtime from the `RejectWifi` section of the REFramework UI, open with Insert key [INS]

To uninstall the mod, delete `RejectWifi.dll` from `reframework/plugins`.

**Main features**
- Automatically and silently declines opponents reported by the game as using Wi-Fi.

Optional features:
- log declined Wi-Fi matches
- open the matchmaking settings window after a connection error
- independently enable for Ranked, Casual and Avatar matchmaking
- optional randomized delay before declining a match - you need to turn on "Confirm opponent" for this

**Requirements**
REFramework

tags: VGB Fed and Hydration Duration Increase
Increases Fed and Hydration buffs by 4/2 hours.
If you want to make a more complicated system using mine as a base, feel free, just be sure to give the proper credit :)
messages.content:
Hungry?  Thirsty?

This mod increases the duration of Fed and Hydration.

That's it, no other changes to the buff.

Fed duration increased to 4 hours.
Hydration duration increased to 2 hours.

Hydration question:  Why only 2 hours?
Hydration Answer:  Because it makes sense to me you would get thirsty faster than hungry.

Note:  

Mod is not retroactive.  If you already had the buff before installing you will need to eat and drink again to see the new duration.

Issues:

This mod does not alter the Food/Drink items to show the new duration, it will still shows 30 minutes on the items. I am not going to fix this as this mod still does what I want it to do and the food showing the un modded duration has no detrimental effect, the timer in your buffs shows correctly.  If it bugs you, feel free to make a patch that fixes it.

Q:  Why increase durations at all?

A:  Because I am an old dude and forget to eat/drink all the time.  Even with the increase I still forget, but at least when I do remember it lasts longer and I don't have to carry as much food that adds weight.

tags: VGB Well Rested and Emotional Security Duration Increase
Increases duration of Well Rested and Emotional Security to 2/4 hours.
messages.content:
Need a rest?

This mod increases the duration of Well Rested and Emotional Security so you don't have to try to rest every 24 minutes.  

That's it.  There are no other changes or additions.

Well Rested duration increase to 2 hours
Emotional Security duration increase to 4 hours.

Compatibility: 

After switching to .esm I had to make a patch.  With patch verified compatible with Immersive Love Perk by [InquisitorOverhaulsReturn](https://www.nexusmods.com/starfield/users/132105373) located here [https://www.nexusmods.com/starfield/mods/8837](https://www.nexusmods.com/starfield/mods/8837)

I altered the duration, nothing else so it MAY be compatible with others that add bonuses if they don't alter duration.

Other than keeping up with Starfield version updates if necessary, I will not be adding anything else to this mod.

### Description
Replaces all Euphorika bar music with Euphoria by Kendrick Lamar.

### Installation instructions
Make sure your StarfieldCustom.ini contains the following lines before you install any mods for this game.

`[Archive]`
`bInvalidateOlderFiles=1`
`sResourceDataDirsFinal=`

## Manual method:
1. Download the mod manually
2. Extract the archive file
3. Put the Data folder in \common\Starfield\Data

The Vortex method is very straightforward; no instructions are necessary.

None
